svg.text: home — 1. every file and what it needs
An arrow A → B: A needs B; a need that follows along other arrows is not drawn again. Files of one kind in one folder are one box (the rooms' data files, the product groups, the textures).
room/ — the room engine and the rooms' data
core/ — shared code, knows no project
library/ — what is bought (data) and how it is drawn
home — 2. the folders, each on its own
Each folder with the lines inside it; under its title, the folders it needs.
room/ — the room engine and the rooms' data
core/ — shared code, knows no project
library/ — what is bought (data) and how it is drawn
uses (a script or style tag; or a module its code calls)
JSON: a data file, pure JSON handed to HOME.data(…), no code (named .js only so that a page opened from disk can load it)
code: a script (page, module); style: core/ui.css

61 files: 18 code, 41 JSON, 1 page, 1 style. External (CDN, no lines): three.js r128, OrbitControls, SheetJS 0.18.5, Alpine.js 3.14.1, Google Fonts. Not drawn: *.md, archon/, jsconfig.json, globals.d.ts, the tests (test/).
